decisionsTitle: The volunteers' page: the button in a new tab, the public count a tick, the date of birth, a kinder note
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-14, the evening after the volunteers' page shipped (§768), four asks, and «YOLO» for the open points:** (1) «„Vreau să fiu voluntar” ar trebui să fiu un buton care să deschidă o pagină nouă în alt tab»; (2) «vreau să bifez dacă să afișez sau nu numărătoarea voluntarilor — știi că am mai avut probleme din astea»; (3) «În loc de vârstă vreau să treacă data nașterii»; (4) «Și pusă o notă mai drăguță» under «Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci». Amends §761 (the roles' counts), §765 (what a volunteer says about themselves, the card's ticks) and §768 (the callout, the age rules); builds on §754 and §771's trace.

**A. «Vreau să fiu voluntar» opens in a new tab.** The event page's callout button (`VolunteerCallout`) is a link with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener"`, the house's pattern for a link that leaves the page (`LegalLink`, §197): the new-tab mark (`OpenInNewIcon`, decorative) after the words, and an accessible name that says it in words — `Event.opensInNewTab`, «se deschide într-o filă nouă» — because a title does not exist on a touch screen. The button keeps its own glyph before the words and its 44 pixels. `ButtonLink` passes `target` and `rel` through (it picked `href` alone). The volunteers' page keeps its back link in the same tab, as the owner said.

**B. «Arată public câți voluntari mai sunt necesari» is the card's third tick** — the §634 rule («Arată public câți așteaptă») on the volunteers' count: `events.volunteers_show_counts`, **off by default**, so an existing event shows no number until the club ticks it. The same pattern as «Oferim tricouri voluntarilor» (§765): a submit drawn as the checkbox that posts `on=1|0`, never a toggle, in the card's own form, audited `event.volunteers_counts_switched` with `{ on }` and nothing of a person, never `events.version` (it is no edit of the page's text), the public pages told through the cache tags. **One flag governs every public number about volunteers**: the per-role line under a role's box on the volunteers' page reads «mai sunt necesare 3 persoane» while it is on and «mai sunt locuri» / “spots still open” while it is off; a role that is full stays unoffered either way (§761). The event page's callout never said a number and still does not (the line names the roles only). The card always has the numbers («N din M», «De repartizat»). **Decided, the owner having said «YOLO»:** the event's JSON file (§751) carries none of it — the same rule as «Primește voluntari» and the shirts (§754): the tick belongs to one date, a copy of an event and an import as new start with it off, an import over an event leaves the target's own; the brief's «the event JSON carries it» was read as «the file must not lose it», which a file that carries nothing of the volunteers' settings cannot.

**C. «Data nașterii» instead of «Vârsta».** The public form and the organizers' entry ask the registration form's own box — `BirthDateField` (typed day first, the Maskito mask, the date in words with the age on the event's day under it, the plain text box with scripts off that the server reads in every tolerant shape, `normalizeTypedDate`) — with its words from the catalogue the registration form reads (`Registration.birthDate`, `birthDateEcho`, `birthDatePlaceholder`, `birthDateUnreadable`); the component gained `size` and `fullWidth` and nothing else. **The age is derived, on the event's day**: the gun's day when the race has one, else the event's day, in the event's own zone (`volunteerEventDay`, the same counting as the registration form's `formViewOf`); an event whose date is still to be announced counts today, and the next save counts again. The minimum of fourteen (§768) and the guardian under eighteen are judged from that age: someone who turns fourteen before the race may offer today, someone who turns eighteen on the morning of the race is an adult, someone who turns eighteen the day after is a minor, a leap-day birth turns a year older on 1 March in a common year (`ageOn`). A date after the event, or more than a hundred years back, is refused on the box. **Stored**: `event_volunteers.date_of_birth` (date, nullable, migration `0159`), and the `age` column **still written** — the age on the event's day, at every save — so the guardian, the confirm gate, the agreement and the emails keep reading one number; the age is the day's, the date the person's (an event moved to another day changes the age at the next save, the trail names `age`). **A row from before has an age and no date**; saving it with the date box empty keeps that age (so a corrected telephone number never turns a person of sixteen into an adult with no guardian, and wipes no guardian's data), and the box says so in a line; a date typed replaces it. The card's row reads «17 ani (12.03.2009)», a row with no date «17 ani»; the CSV has the date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) in a new column right after «Vârsta»; «Toate datele unei persoane» lists «Data nașterii: 12.03.2009» beside the age; the trail names the box (`birthDate`) and never the date. The parent's boxes on the public form follow the date typed (`GuardianFields` reads the date box the way the registration form's `GuardianForMinor` does, and counts on the event's day), always shown with scripts off. A refusal says one of three sentences: no minors yet, «cel puțin 14 ani în ziua evenimentului», or the registration form's «Scrie data ca zi, lună, an». **Privacy**: the notice's template says «data nașterii» (with «din care calculăm vârsta ta în ziua evenimentului») where §765's said the age; the `{{volunteerProfile}}` gate is unchanged, and its quoted labels now read the registration form's «Data nașterii» — so a notice approved from the earlier template keeps saying «vârsta» in its own sentence beside the new quoted label until the club approves a version from this template (the same sitting as every legal text, item 16 of CLAUDE.md's list); nothing is hardcoded in any text but the template.

**D. The kinder note.** The owner's words, verbatim, with the diacritics fixed and «contact» made «contacta»: «În funcție de numărul de doritori, există posibilitatea să fie nevoie să acoperi o altă responsabilitate. Mulțumim pentru dorința de a ajuta. Te vom contacta curând.» / “Depending on how many people sign up, you may be asked to cover a different responsibility. Thank you for wanting to help. We will contact you soon.” — a caption in the form's own style (`body2`, secondary) right under the roles' list, before the next field, tied to the group by `aria-describedby`; the short instruction line stays above the roles.

**Refused.** A new component for the date (the registration form's is reused); a second mask or a native `<input type="date">` (§561, §578); an age typed beside the date (one fact, one box); deriving the age on every read (`age` is a column other rules read, and a recomputation would change a person's guardian state under the organizers without a save); putting the volunteers' tick in the event's file; saying a number about volunteers on the event's page.
changelogLine: - **The volunteers' page, four small things** — «Vreau să fiu voluntar» opens the page in a new tab; «Arată public câți voluntari mai sunt necesari» is a tick on the event (off by default: the page says «mai sunt locuri», not a number); the form asks «Data nașterii» instead of the age, counted on the event's day, with the date beside the age on the card, in the CSV and in the person's data; and the owner's kinder note sits under the roles. Migration `0159`; approve the privacy notice from the new template. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 36, 37, 38 and 39. Given an event that takes volunteers, when a visitor opens its page `/ro/evenimente/<slug>/voluntari`, then each role says how many people it still needs («mai sunt necesare 3 persoane») only while the event's «Arată public câți voluntari mai sunt necesari» is ticked (off by default) and says «mai sunt locuri» otherwise — no number anywhere on the page, a role that is full unoffered either way — and «Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci» is followed right under the list by the owner's note («În funcție de numărul de doritori, există posibilitatea să fie nevoie să acoperi o altă responsabilitate. Mulțumim pentru dorința de a ajuta. Te vom contacta curând.») while the short instruction stays above the roles (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 37 and 38. Given a privacy notice in force that names `{{volunteerProfile}}`, when a visitor opens the volunteers' page, then the form asks «Data nașterii» — the registration form's own box, typed day first with its mask, a plain text box with scripts off, its date in words and its words from the registration catalogue — instead of the age, and judges the minimum of 14 and the guardian under 18 from the age the date gives on the event's day (the gun's day, else the event's, in its own zone): 14 today, 14 tomorrow and 14 on the morning of the race are taken, thirteen on the event's day or a date after it is refused on `birthDate`, eighteen on the morning of the race is an adult, eighteen the next day a minor, a birth on 29 February turns a year older on 1 March; the parent's boxes follow the date typed, always shown with scripts off, and the kept row has the date and the age on the event's day (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event that takes volunteers, when a visitor opens its page, then «Vreau să fiu voluntar» is a link with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener"`, a glyph before its words, the new-tab mark after them and the accessible name «Vreau să fiu voluntar — se deschide într-o filă nouă», at least 44 pixels tall, and the line above it names the roles and says no number; pressed, it opens the volunteers' page in a second tab and leaves the event's page where it was (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 120, 121, 136 and 147. Given the event's «Voluntari» card, then «Arată public câți voluntari mai sunt necesari» is the third tick of the card — a form whose submit is drawn as a checkbox (`role="checkbox"`, `aria-checked`, at least 44 pixels, working with scripts off), one press and no «Salvează», off by default, posting the state it wants — audited `event.volunteers_counts_switched` with `{ on }` and nothing of a person, never moving the event's `version`, refused for any role that may not manage volunteers, and written by neither the event's save, a copy of the event nor the event's JSON file; the card's «N din M» are shown whichever way it is (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 121 and 148. Given the card's entry of a person by hand or the change of one, when it carries «Data nașterii» (the registration form's own box, optional), then the row keeps the date in `event_volunteers.date_of_birth` and the age it gives on the event's day in `age`, recomputed at every save (an event moved to another day changes it at the next save, the trail naming `age`); an empty box on a row from before the date keeps the age it held, and the guardian with it, and a date typed replaces it; the row reads «17 ani (12.03.2009)», or «17 ani» with no date; the CSV has «Data nașterii» (`YYYY-MM-DD`) right after «Vârsta»; «Toate datele unei persoane» lists «Data nașterii: 12.03.2009»; the audit names `birthDate` and never the date; a date posted while the notice in force does not name `{{volunteerProfile}}` is refused on `birthDate` (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Migration `0159_volunteers_counts_birth_date` is expand-only: it adds `events.volunteers_show_counts` (boolean, `NOT NULL`, default false) and `event_volunteers.date_of_birth` (date, nullable); a volunteer listed before it keeps their age and has no date, and every event shows no public count until its club ticks it (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 65. Given the privacy notice's template, then its volunteers' paragraph says «data nașterii» / “date of birth” (from which the age on the day of the event is calculated) where it said the age, the quoted labels of `{{volunteerProfile}}` read the registration form's «Data nașterii» and «Sex», and the gate that holds the form back until a notice names the marker is unchanged; a notice approved from the earlier template keeps saying «vârsta» in its own sentence until the club approves a version from this one (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
